notes.title: Bears Can’t Drift!? 2.95: Audio update, GDC and EGX Rezzed
notes.content:
This is going to be (fingers crossed) the last update before the final release of Bears Can’t Drift!? There is still a little bit of work to go but I’m confident I can get all the work done before the end of spring.

[h1]Audio Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]End of Race win
[*]Start of Race
[*]UI-Rollover
[*]Select
[*]Add Player
[*]Cancel
[*]Boost Sfx wasn’t spacialised
[*]Music and BG audio fades on level load
[*]Music now plays in all game modes
[/list]

[h1]Fix List[/h1]
[list]
[*]Second tier rocket uses old particle system
[*]Braking at low speed is too strong
[*]Make stopping easier
[*]Animate Race UI
[*]Pickups now pop in and out
[*]Pickups are made larger
[*]Wind effect doesn’t play in time trial mode
[*]Intro camera sequence added to all maps
[*]Visual feedback for mushroom spawn powerup

notes.title: Bears Can’t Drift!? 2.9: Readability and cleanup
notes.content:
Bears Can’t Drift!? 2.9: Readability and cleanup

Bears Can’t Drift!? is getting really close to being finished! Only a few sfx/music tracks and a bit more polish left! I have a nice long list of fixes and improvements for you to test out. Let me know what you think in the forums :D 

[h1]Fix list[/h1]
[list]
[*]Picnic UI now displays correct rank
[*]Added unique icons to each map in hub worlds
[*]Changed turning, accelerating and looking to analogue inputs
[*]Updated foliage in Ruin worlds
[*]Auto detect console mode
[*]Adjusted hat sizes
[*]Updated ruin buildings
[*]Fixed arrow guides Ruin tracks
[*]AI Picks random bear from collection
[*]Added flags to ruin hub
[*]Texture broken Road sections in lava level
[*]Added intro animation to difficulty options
[*]Fixed portal collision
[*]Tiled portal images
[*]Texture hat baseball cap
[*]Improved paws menu responsiveness
[*]Animated paws menu
[*]Picnic now spawns you facing the right way
[*]Replaced picnic baskets with large food
[*]Improved ai track navigation
[*]Fixed restart option in hub worlds
[*]Driving into a hat automatically sets it as active
[*]Timetrial UI now displays correctly in multiplayer
[*]Made Deleting save data option clearer
[*]Fixed collision in core hub world
[*]Intro camera animations for race play on all tracks
[*]Player camera now does collision tests
[/list]


[h1]Audio Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]Music Ruins Racing track
[*]Rocket fire and explode
[*]Mortor hit
[*]boost
[/list]

Thanks,
Arran

notes.title: BCD!?: 2.8, 32bit build and Hub UI!
notes.content:
[h1]32Bit version added[/h1]
There is now a 32bit version of the game. The minimum requirements will stay at 64bit and the game will load 64bit by default. I recommend using caution when buying this game for a 32bit machine and make sure you are happy with frame rate etc.. before passing the returns policy deadline :) The game does require a moderately high spec machine to run so always check the recommended specs on the product page before buying.

[h1]Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Track guides added to more tracks
[*]Added shield sfx
[*]Added Flags to ruin tracks
[*]d-pad on paws menu now works
[*]pickups now face the right direction
[*]Pickups now animate in and out
[*]New icon for salmon rocket
[*]Unique icon for multi-rocket
[*]Double boost effect
[*]Hats have been moved to respective tracks
[*]Improved UI for hub world
[*]Added UI to credits mini game
[/list]

notes.title: BCD!?: 2.7, Achievements and mini game.
notes.content:
[h1]Added remaining acheivments[/h1]
Head over to the achievements page to check them out! There are 16 in total.

[h1]Special Thanks mini game[/h1]
I wanted to make something more interesting and fun than the usual list of names at the end of the game. While this has been a solo project for the vast majority of developement, many people offered critique, advise and help bringing it together. The 'Special Thanks' mini game is completable but is missing a UI element which is coming in the next update. Good luck finding it and thanks to everyone in the game.  


[h1]Updated Graphical assets[/h1]
I have created a new header image that I hope makes the game stand out a little more in your library, let me know what you think!

[h1]Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Textured Scifi ceiling
[*]Created underside for lighthouse
[*]Animated Picnic end sequence
[*]Animated Timetrial lap sequence
[*]Animated Paws menu icons
[*]Improved track directing on arctic tracks
[*]Improved collision on forest night and evening
[*]Stopped hats popping in 
[*]Stopped mortor rockets popping in 
[*]Player spawns looking in the wrong direction
[*]Improved Arctic ocean shader
[*]Snow particle effect while driving over snow.
[*]Pickups now bob animatedly when picked up
[*]Lightmapped several assets
[*]Stop camera switching while in player select mode
[*]Increased Security for remaining tracks
[/list]

As always, I hope you enjoy the latest update of Bears Can't Drift!? and if you have any critique or issues then let me know in the discussion board :)

Thanks,
Arran

notes.title: BCD!?: 2.5 New maps and more!
notes.content:
[h1]All maps released[/h1]
You can now play all 12 maps in Bears Can't Drift!? Major work still needs to be done to the tracks. The ruin hub (red zone) tracks are all made to blockout stage at the moment so the next few updates will be to improve visual fidelity to match the forest (green zone) tracks. You should notice yellow hammers at the entrance to some portals to let you know which tracks are still under construction. 4 tracks have been added to the ruins hub (Red zone)and 1 track added to Arctic hub (Blue zone).

[h1]Paws menu Graphics options[/h1]
Paws menu has new artwork added (animations still to come). The add player icons now represent the difficulty mode to let you know which diff mode you are in. Difficulty modes should be added in the next update, at the moment its still locked to Medium. You can now access the graphics control panel by pressing LB(L1) or RB(R1) in the Paws menu. It is currently locked to mouse input only, you can control all the effects that were in the previous build. Fullscreen, Vsync, quality and resolution, art assets are still being developed for this.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
3 achievements are currently obtainable, Activate Easy, Medium and Hard. More achievements will be added and implemented in the coming weeks, post any suggestions for achievemnts on the forums.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/338040/achievements] Achievements[/url]

[h1]Hats[/h1]
Cosmetic hats have been added to Bears Can't Drift!? Lock icons can be found throughout the hub worlds which will turn into hats when you unlock them. Hats are hidden throughout the 12 tracks and game modes. In order to unlock them you must find the hat and come in first place. Currently you can unlock two hats, more will be added over the next few weeks!
[img]http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-X717V--aOOo/VirRT_Z9f6I/AAAAAAAADDQ/TjI5JMplFWw/s1600/HatsMisc.png[/img]

[h1]New playable character[/h1]
Robobear is a new playable character that can be unlocked. Like with previous new characters, press select while in the hub world and move left and right to change character.
[img]http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-2xoKhwl38aM/VkKCqc9-s4I/AAAAAAAADMo/64v5x1kMF-U/s1600/_0003_Robo.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy the game and as always, any feedback on the game is welcome :)

Thanks,
Arran
Dev

notes.title: BCD!?: 2.3 Weapon changes, new arctic track and character!
notes.content:
[h1]Removing some weapon combinations.[/h1]
I have done a lot of experimenting with the weapon combo system and have come to the conclusion that it is too complicated. After getting a lot of feedback I found people really struggled to remember all of the different combinations. Because of this I am lowering the weapon combinations to same item only (from 14 total to 8 total). If you pick up two of the same item, it changes to a super power item. After play testing this I found people picked up the game much more easily, were able to be more tactical and remember the combinations. I hate removing content, but I genuinely feel that it makes the game better, if you have any feedback on this please let me know in the forum. I will change the description page to match the changes made.

Improvements have been made to the second tier weapons so they all work as intended. Some more work is still to come for the visual side. Animations for the mushroom drop and chicken attack still need work as well as more particle effects and SFX for all weapons.

[h1]New Player Character[/h1]
I have added the polar bear to the roster of playable characters! You can change your character any time in the hub world by pressing select on your gamepad and then moving left/right with the analogue stick to switch between characters!

[h1]New Arctic Track[/h1]
A new arctic track has been added to the game! Check it out in the arctic hub world.

[h1]Second tier drift[/h1]
If you hold the drift for long enough you now get a second tier hit of speed. You get much more speed but a lot less control.

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added clover to forest world
[*]Foliage interaction in the forest world
[*]Mushroom drop throws you into the air
[*]Some bears have crowns in the hub world when they shouldn’t
[/list]

As always, thanks for checking out Bears Can’t Drift!? and let me know what you think of the game in the forums :)

Thanks,
Arran
Dev

notes.title: BCD!?: 2.2 Custom Characters
notes.content:
We have quite a few changes for this update and I will do my best to go through them all. We took the game to EGX a few weeks ago and got tones of feedback. Changes have been made to both format and game mode which I hope you like!

[h1]Custom Characters[/h1]
You can now choose between three characters. As well as the basic bear, there is also a panda and a skeleton (ready for halloween)! There are some issues with character animation which we will hopefully have fixed by the next update. Let us know on the forums what bear you want to play as!

To change character. In the hub world press select on the controller and switch between the characters using the left analogue stick. Use the right analogue stick to change the colour of the kart.

[h1]Ambient sfx[/h1]
Ambient background sounds have been added to all tracks. More work is being done on the kart SFX.

[h1]Removed level streaming.[/h1]
You can no longer seamlessly travel between hub worlds. Unfortunately there were some issues maintaining a descent frame rate. To move between worlds you now use the portals (which on the plus side is much quicker)

[h1]Difficulty modes[/h1]
Difficulty select has been disabled for now while more work is being done on it, hopefully we should have that back up soon. The actuall select map for it has also been moved. Doing this will hopefully create a clearer path for the player. Now the player goes from the intro screen to the difficulty select paths into the monitoring station. From there you can choose which hub world you want to go to.

[h1]Intro video placeholder[/h1]
An intro video has been added to the start of the game. This will be replaced with a higher quality version soon.

[h1]Options menu[/h1]
The options menu has been disable while some mainenace is being done to it. At the moment it doesn't save your choices which I'm currnently working on fixing.

[h1]And more[/h1]
[list]
[*]Paths added to forest hub world
[*]Forest 1 has been opened up in Picnic mode
[*]321go UI is now shared across all screens
[*]Icons for difficulty modes are now in world
[*]Bee hive drop no longer spawns off center
[*]major improvements to position tracking in single race
[*]single race now has a timer for remaining players once race is finished.
[*]Removed arrow in picnic game mode
[*]Baskets now auto refill in picnic game mode
[*]All baskets are visible from the start
[*]Lap checkpoints are clearer
[*]Salmon rocket speed increased
[*]Kart turning circle improved while at low speed
[*]Reversing is quicker 
[*]Reversing has a tighter turning circle
[*]Alpha bear now slows down in the hub world
[*]Orb indicator has been replaced by a crown in the hub world
[*]Fullscreen by default
[*]Minor improvements to animations
[/list]

A big thank you to everyone who has given feedback so far. A lot of the changes are down to what people have told us on the forums and during EGX. Please keep the feedback coming and let me know if there are any issues with the latest build.

Thanks,
Arran

notes.title: BCD!?: 2.1 Ruins Hub world and more
notes.content:
[h1]Ruins Hub World[/h1]
The ruins hub world is now available and can be accessed from the sci-fi monitoring station. Most of the artwork is still at placeholder but I wanted to get some feedback on it, so let me know what you think :D 
[img]http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-oH_aHPQTHss/VfLqUbrzfTI/AAAAAAAACjo/CWPo_HuuFpQ/s1600/RuinUpdate3.png[/img]

[h1]UI[/h1]
I have been going through and swapping out the UI with more polished versions. Still a lot to go, the paws menu is still in need of a lot more work and you will hopefully see improvements in the next update.
[img]http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-DChZx4H9gEE/VfLr_or86kI/AAAAAAAACkc/jRpJ-AgqadM/s1600/UIUpdate.png[/img]

[h1]Difficulty Modes[/h1]
Starting to implement the difficulty modes so be warned! At the moment I'm focusing on player speed so let me know if you think hard is too quick, easy is too slow etc... Also weapon locking is in for easy mode so you can't combo in easy mode. Any suggestions would be appreciated on what kind of difficulty changes you would like to see.

[h1]Delete Save Data[/h1]
There is now an icon in the middle of the Sci-fi monitoring station that if you drive on will delete your save data. Working on making this more obvious that it will happen but in the meantime be careful!
[img]http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-iHz8K0kjC9E/VfL34WcCpxI/AAAAAAAACk4/DBwd6Fckswg/s1600/ScifiSection.png[/img]


[h1]Additional updates[/h1]
- Minor AI improvements
- Reduced Cam shake when landing 
- AI now get fat in Picnic mode
- Idle animations
- Minor detail added to environments
- Minor improvements to boost
- Intro camera plays on all tracks
- Exit portal placed in time trial mode
- Ai Slow down when hit
- Minor artistic improvements made to Sci-fi area
- Boost now works in mid air
- Bear gets wet in water
- Bear gets covered in honey when hitting a bee hive
- Optimisation to level structure means our file size has gone down from 2.5gb to 1.8gb 
- Added credits to intro screen

Thanks to everyone who has posted feedback on the game so far. If you have any thoughts on the game, good or bad, let me know in the forum :D It would be great to hear from you!

Thanks,
Arran Langmead

notes.title: BCD!?: Mini Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hello again my fellow bears :) Many people on the forums have been asking for a graphics control panel so I spent a bit of time putting one together. You can access it by pressing "Select/back" on the gamepad or "enter" on the keyboard.

[h1]Control Panel features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fullscreen
[*]vsync
[*]Screen resolution
[*]Quality settings; Low, Medium, High
[/list]

[h1]Change log[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added visual cues to Boost X Shield
[*]Added visual cues to Hive X Shield
[*]Added visual cues to Boost X Boost
[*]Hive X Boost now drops multiple hives
[*]Boost start now works
[*]Fixed music not looping
[*]Improved bump off surroundings
[*]No more confetti for last place
[*]Spawn location issues in single race
[*]Mortor shots now hit the player and targets lead bear.
[*]Added a quality setting control panel.
[*]Esc key now closes the game
[*]Basket visually depletes when you drive through
[*]Enemy AI can now use all weapons
[/list]

[h1]Next Update Plans[/h1]
The next update is going to be a big one! Update 2.0 will be coming in the next couple of weeks and unlocks the arctic hub world and sci-fi monitoring station. Thanks again for all your feedback so far :)
